role: Earn a reply containing the reader’s bookkeeping question
subject: Bookkeeping support from Ledgerloop
preview_text: Start the conversation with the question that matters to you.
body:
Ledgerloop offers bookkeeping support for small businesses. If you’re considering bookkeeping support, you can begin with the question that matters to you.

There’s no need to describe your entire bookkeeping setup in the first message. Write the question in your own words, and include only the context you think is relevant. If you want to know whether Ledgerloop supports a particular bookkeeping task, ask that directly.

Replying starts a conversation with Ledgerloop about your question. It can be broad or specific, about your bookkeeping or the support you’re considering. Send it as it stands.
